metadataRaw.title: How to Loosen a Stiff Knee in SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates exercises that can quickly relieve a stiff knee.

This video is ideal for anyone experiencing pain or discomfort when trying to straighten or open their knee due to arthritis or muscle strain.

The exercises increase blood flow and improve the circulation of synovial fluid, essentially "lubricating" the knee. They focus on loosening tight muscles and strengthening them for lasting relief.

Since each exercise targets the knee in a unique way, it's best to try them all and use the ones that work best for you.

Watch now and start loosening that stiff knee!

Link to coconut massage oil: https://amzn.to/4aERcZz

0:00 Intro

3:30 Knee Slides
